Dukan ERP support

Answers to common questions about signing in, stores, staff, stock, sales, returns, subscriptions and account deletion.

Signing in

Sign in with the email address or WhatsApp number of your account and your password. An employee whose sign-in no longer works should ask the business owner or a manager to check that their account is active. An owner who cannot sign in can write to support with the business name.

Verification codes

A verification code is sent to the contact being verified and expires after a few minutes. If it does not arrive, wait until the app or the page allows a new request. When no delivery channel is available, the app and this website say so, and nothing is changed.

Stores

The owner requests an additional store, or a different activity for a store, from the business account on this website. The change is activated once TSX-MR has confirmed it.

Staff

Each store’s subscription includes staff seats, and more seats are requested from the business account. The owner invites employees from the app and chooses their permissions, store by store.

Stock and products

Products are added in the app by scanning a barcode, typing, or importing a supplier file. Phones and other serialised devices are recorded by IMEI or serial number.

Sales and payments

Sales are recorded in the app, in cash or through the payment accounts the business configures. Financial records are never erased: a mistake is corrected by a new, recorded entry.

Returns and refunds

Returns and refunds are recorded in the app with their reason. Stock and money are adjusted together, and the day’s report shows them.

Subscriptions

The owner sees the status, the period and every request by signing in to the business account on this website. The mobile app shows whether access is active and contains no purchases. Payments are confirmed by TSX-MR against the payment’s reference.

Deleting an account

An account is deleted in the app, from More, then Your account, then Delete account. The account deletion page explains what happens and what is kept.

Deleting a Dukan ERP account

Access to the app

The app tells everyone signed in whether the business is active, in its 72-hour grace period, read-only, waiting to start, suspended or refused, and what still works. In read-only, records can be read and reports shared, but nothing new is recorded. The Owner sees why, and what is waiting, by signing in to the business account on this website.

The free trial

The free trial is claimed by the Owner on this website, signed in to the business account, once every contact given at registration is verified. The app only shows its status and its end; nothing in the app starts, extends or pays for it.

A lost phone

Sign in on another phone and sign the lost one out under More → Devices. If you cannot sign in anywhere, ask your Owner, or write to support with the business name.

Importing a stock file

Under Stock → Import stock, choose a spreadsheet file (.xlsx or .csv). The app shows what it found before anything is saved, and rows it cannot read are listed with their reason. A very large file is refused: split it into smaller files.

Scanning IMEI numbers and barcodes

The camera reads IMEI labels and product barcodes. If the camera is not allowed, or a label cannot be read, type the IMEI (15 digits) or the serial number instead: the same checks apply.

Reports and PDF files

The daily closing and the monthly results can be made into a PDF file in the app, then previewed and shared with your phone’s share button. Reports can also be exported as spreadsheet files. Nothing is sent automatically.

Reporting a security problem

If you think you have found a weakness in Dukan ERP, do not test it on real data: see the security page and write to the security address.

Reporting a security problem

Service problems

There is no public status page. When the app cannot reach the service it says so, keeps the actions it can hold on the phone, and sends them when the connection returns.

Contact support

If your question is not answered here, write to the support address below. Give the business name and the contact you sign in with, never a password or a code.
